name: Human Survival
overview: Human survival, according to Scripture, depends fundamentally on God's intervention and our faithful response to His truth. God’s remembrance and preservation of life, as demonstrated in His care for Noah and all living creatures during the flood, shows His sovereign power to save (Genesis 8:1). Salvation is found only by looking to God and enduring in faith until the end (Isaiah 45:22; Matthew 24:13). Believers are warned to remain vigilant and not become distracted by worldly excess or cares, for such distractions can cause them to miss the day of salvation (Luke 21:34). Ultimately, sanctification through God’s Word, which is truth, is essential for spiritual survival (John 17:17), as turning away from God leads to vanity and shame (Psalms 4:2).
